findings.title: AWS secret access key hardcoded into the shipped JS bundle
findings.why_it_matters: Anyone can extract strings from a distributed app binary, so this grants every user the signing credential. Unlike SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, which is publishable by design, this is a server-side secret and must never reach the client.
findings.suggested_fix: Move signUpload behind your backend and have the server sign the ticket; the app should never hold this key.
